articles.title: Why Jemele Hill wants WNBA fans to issue an ‘apology’ to Angel Reese
articles.summary: Sports writer Jemele Hill was ecstatic for Angel Reese after her brilliant performance in Game 3 to help the Atlanta Dream advance to the WNBA Finals. The De...
articles.body:
Sports writer Jemele Hill was ecstatic for Angel Reese after her brilliant performance in Game 3 to help the Atlanta Dream advance to the WNBA Finals.

The Defensive Player of the Year scored 22 points and grabbed 9 boards, while also being an anchor on defence, blocking two shots against the New York Liberty. Rhyne Howard and Jordin Canada also stepped up for the Dream, as they secured an 85-83 win on the night.

Playing in the playoffs for the first time in her career, Reese did not look intimidated and even got into a heated moment with Liberty's Jonquel Jones early in the game.

After her stellar performance, Hill, who has been a big supporter of Reese, took to X and posted a message for WNBA fans.

Jemele Hill asks WNBA fans to apologise to Angel Reese

Reese has been one of the most scrutinised WNBA stars since her arrival in the league. Despite being a former first-round pick, her game has been disrespected by many fans.

Her stint with the Chicago Sky specifically was criticised by many but after moving to Atlanta, things have improved for the 24-year-old.

After her big night against the Liberty, who had championship winners on the roster, Hill posted a message on X.

"Let the apologies be as loud as the disrespect. Whole 'lotta people owe Angel Reese an apology," Hill wrote on her X page.

Reese has been a major part of the Dream's run to the WNBA Finals. She has anchored the defence and also been influential in how the offence operates in Atlanta.

Her ability to defend at an elite level and rebound the ball are qualities that are extremely helpful in the playoffs. Now heading into her first WNBA Finals, Reese will be hoping to continue her good form and win her first championship to silence critics who have criticised her ability as a star in the league.

articles.title: Fantasy Basketball 2026 1st-Round NBA Mock Draft and Top Team Names
articles.summary: For fantasy basketball managers checking back in after the 2026 NBA offseason, there's a lot to catch up on.
articles.body:
For fantasy basketball managers checking back in after the 2026 NBA offseason, there's a lot to catch up on.

And, frankly, not a ton of time to do it with preseason games already underway and the actual season tipping off on Tuesday, Oct. 20.

There is, frankly, far too much to detail here, but the early-round bullet points include Giannis Antetokounmpo's move to the Miami Heat, the Philadelphia 76ers' additions of Jaylen Brown and LeBron James, or the surprise moves involving LaMelo Ball (to the Minnesota Timberwolves) and Ja Morant (to the Portland Trail Blazers).

While you'll hopefully get up to speed quickly, this can help serve as a mini cram session with a simulated mock first round, the biggest debates within those picks and finally a batch of team names that might help take that task off your to-do list.

The debates start as soon as the draft does. Those fortunate enough to hold the No. 1 pick must immediately decide between budding superstar big man Victor Wembanyama and three-time MVP Nikola Jokić.

The good news is that there's no wrong answer here. The honest answer is that it might be format-dependent (Jokić in points leagues, Wembanyama in categories leagues for his defensive playmaking). The fun part, though, is you can really go with your gut—Jokić offers more safety, while Wembanyama makes anything feel possible.

If you wind up with the No. 3 pick, guess what: You have your draft's next big debate on your hands. And it's between the two players who jousted for last season's scoring crown, Luka Dončić (who won it) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (who claimed the 2024-25 scoring crown).

This one generally goes in SGA's direction, as he'll typically post better shooting rates, fewer turnovers and more defensive contributions. That said, Dončić provides more assists and rebounds, and he nearly mirrored SGA in stocks last season (2.1 to 2.2). It's another trust-your-take decision here, as you're going to get a fantasy great.

The draft board starts with a pair of two-player tiers of megastars and superstars. So, what happens for folks holding the No. 5 pick? Well, there are a lot of options here, but which one rises above the rest?

If it's a points league, it might be simple: Giannis Antetokounmpo. He isn't locked in place necessarily, but he is probably the best option on the board. In a categories league, though, he's out (due to his abysmal free-throw shooting), and you're probably choosing between Cade Cunningham and Anthony Edwards.

articles.title: Brandin Podziemski, Warriors Reportedly Agree to $110M Contract, Full Details Revealed
articles.summary: Coming off the best season of his NBA career, Brandin Podziemski has been rewarded with a new contract from the Golden State Warriors.
articles.body:
Coming off the best season of his NBA career, Brandin Podziemski has been rewarded with a new contract from the Golden State Warriors.

According to ESPN's Shams Charania, Podziemski and the Warriors agreed to terms on a five-year, $110 million extension. It includes a mutual fifth-year option for the 2031-32 season and features a trade kicker.

Players With the Most to Prove This Season 🏀

Podziemski's extension comes at something of a pivotal moment for the Warriors. There were rumblings about head coach Steve Kerr's future in the wake of their season-ending loss to the Phoenix Suns in the play-in tournament.

Kerr ultimately decided to return for a 13th season, agreeing to a two-year contract on May 9.

Beyond the brief period when there were questions about who would be coaching Golden State in 2026-27, the roster was also in a state of flux. Jimmy Butler seems likely to miss at least a portion of the season after tearing his ACL in January and undergoing surgery on Feb. 9.

Draymond Green turned down his $27.7 million player option to give the team flexibility if LeBron James wanted to sign with the Warriors. Once James joined the Philadelphia 76ers, Green signed a one-year deal to return to Golden State for the exact $27.7 million salary he previously turned down.

Kristaps Porziņģis did return to the Warriors on a two-year, $40 million deal. Stephen Curry is the only sure thing for the Warriors going into next season, but even he's coming off season in which he missed 39 games due to injuries.

The Warriors still had Podziemski under contract next season in the final year of his rookie deal, but signing him to an extension now gives them some future security as he continues to ascend.

A first-round pick in the 2023 NBA draft, Podziemski has established himself as an essential piece of Golden State's rotation over the past three seasons. The 23-year-old was one of 18 players who appeared in all 82 games during the 2025-26 campaign.

Podziemski finished fourth on the Warriors in scoring average with 13.8 points per game. He shot 37.1 percent from three on 5.0 attempts per game.

There aren't a lot of long-term building blocks in Golden State right now. Podziemski is still working his way up to that level, but he has shown enough as more has been put on his plate to suggest the Warriors can rely on him as a quality role player going forward.

articles.title: 76ers' VJ Edgecombe Says Representing Bahamas at Olympics Would Mean More Than NBA Title
articles.summary: Philadelphia 76ers star VJ Edgecombe would take great pride in representing the Bahamas in the Summer Olympics.
articles.body:
Philadelphia 76ers star VJ Edgecombe would take great pride in representing the Bahamas in the Summer Olympics.

On a Twitch stream with teammate Sixers Jaylen Brown, Edgecombe said that would be more significant for him than winning an NBA championship:

Within a basketball context, simply appearing in the Olympics is something American fans and players might take for granted. Qualification is all but guaranteed, and anything short of winning a gold medal is generally considered a massive disappointment for the U.S.

The Bahamas men's basketball team is still waiting to make its Olympic debut.

Leading up to the 2024 Games in Paris, the squad advanced to a qualifying tournament in Valencia, Spain. It beat Finland, Poland and Lebanon before losing to Spain in the final. Edgecombe had 12 points, six rebounds and five assists in an 86-78 loss.

It's safe to assume the second-year wing would love to help bring a title to Philly. But guiding the Bahamas to the Olympics would write Edgecombe into his country's basketball history forever.

If choosing between the two, the latter sounds more meaningful.

articles.title: Warriors' Brandin Podziemski reportedly agrees to 5-year, $110 million rookie-scale extension
articles.summary: Podziemski, 23, averaged 13.8 points and 5.1 rebounds for Golden State last season.
articles.body:
Brandin Podziemski has secured a fully guaranteed rookie-scale extension from the Golden State Warriors, according to ESPN's Shams Charania , who reported Saturday that the 23-year-old guard has agreed to a five-year, $110 million deal with the organization.

The contract includes a mutual option in the fifth year (2031-32) and a trade kicker, per Charania. It also assures the 2023 No. 19 overall pick that he's part of the Warriors' long-term plans. He will now avoid restricted free agency next summer.

As for the mutual option specifically, according to ESPN , it allows either side to opt in, not out, of the deal's final season. In the offseason leading up to that campaign, Podziemski and the Warriors will be afforded the opportunity to engage in potential extension conversations.

Podziemski, whom Golden State drafted out of Santa Clara, averaged a career-high 13.8 points last season. He also piled up 5.1 rebounds, 3.7 assists and 1.1 steals per game in 2025-26 while shooting 45.5% from the field and 37.1% from 3.

His durability came in handy. He was one of 18 NBA players who played all 82 games last go-around, per Charania, who also noted that Podziemski ranks top three in charges drawn throughout his young career.

Podziemski has upped his scoring average each of his three seasons in Golden State. Now entering Year 4, the final year of his rookie contact, he was the first player general manager Mike Dunleavy drafted. Podziemski's extension will kick in for the 2027-28 season.

He will reportedly make $18.9 million in his first season on his new contract. That slightly lower figure will provide the Warriors more cap flexibility in 2027-28. That could help Dunleavy supplement a veteran-heavy roster featuring Stephen Curry.

Podziemski is set to begin this season starting alongside Curry in the Warriors' backcourt. He brings much-needed youth to an aging Golden State squad.

Without recovering wings Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody, and center Kristaps Porziņģis — who is out indefinitely with a health issue — Podziemski's contributions will be especially vital.

articles.title: Josh Hart Says 'Everything's Going to Work Out' After Knicks Table Contract Talks Before NBA Season
articles.summary: The New York Knicks have tabled contract extension talks with center Karl-Anthony Towns and guard Josh Hart, but Hart isn't worried as the defending champions get ready for the season.
articles.body:
The New York Knicks have tabled contract extension talks with center Karl-Anthony Towns and guard Josh Hart, but Hart isn't worried as the defending champions get ready for the season.

In a statement released Friday, a Knicks spokesperson confirmed the team will pause all contract talks as the team prepares to defend its NBA title.

"As an organization, our entire focus is on preparing for the upcoming season and delivering another year for our fans to be proud of. As a result, we will not be negotiating contract extensions until later in the season and will remain solely focused on preparing for the start of the season."

Per ESPN's Bobby Marks , Towns, Hart and guards Miles McBride and Tyler Kolek are eligible for extensions.

Towns is eligible for a four-year, $276 million deal. The Knicks offered him a four-year deal worth about $200 million, the New York Post 's Stefan Bondy reported.

Towns is making $57 million this season and can become a free agent next offseason if he declines his $61.1 million player option.

Last season, Towns averaged 20.1 points on 50.1 percent shooting, 11.8 rebounds and 3.0 assists per game.

Hart is eligible for a contract extension of four years and up to approximately $132 million, per James L. Edwards III of The Athletic.

He will make $20.9 million this season. The Knicks hold a team option for $22.3 million in 2027-28. Hart averaged 12.0 points, 7.4 rebounds and 4.8 assists in 66 starts last season.

Obviously, Towns and Hart played invaluable roles en route to helping guide the Knicks to their first championship since 1973, and it behooves New York to get long-term deals done with both of them. Contracts don't appear imminent for either, which is a bit more worrisome in Towns' case since he can elect free agency next season.

In the meantime, the Knicks are focused on their title defense beginning Oct. 20 against the Philadelphia 76ers.

articles.summary: Derrotó al Leyma con un segundo cuarto (11-29) clave en el choque. Llegón a ganar por 32 puntos
articles.body: El Casademont Zaragoza firmó un partido casi perfecto para aplastar a los coruñeses (71-92). Estudió al rival en el primer cuarto, lo aniquiló en el segundo y lo contuvo en los dos últimos cuartos. El Leyma sigue teniendo problemas defensivos, aunque en esta ocasión también se le juntaron los bajos porcentajes tanto de dos como en el triple. Era un artido entre dos equipos que llegaban con una victoria y una derrota. Tanto Leyma como Casademont son candidatos para luchar por la salvación y se presumía un partido igualado, pero al final el dominio total de los visitantes decantó la balanza. Las ventajas al principio de ambos eran cortas. Debutaba Tomas Dimsa en los locales y su tarjeta de presentación fueron tres lanzamientos de tres convertidos. El Coliseum se frota las manos tras superar la lesión de gemelo del lituano que mantenía al Leyma en el marcador tras el primer cuarto (17-23). Por parte maña un gran cuarto de Blumbergs con seis puntos y tres rebotes. En el segundo cuarto el equipo zaragozano comenzó con una marcha más que los gallegos. Liderados por Homesley con diez puntos en los prmeros seis minutos de cuarto y con un cien por cien tanto en triples como en canastas de dos. Se le sumaban Birutis, dominador de la zona (12 puntos) y Blumbergs con ocho puntos y dos triples. Casademont conseguía irse en el marcador (26-44) a un minuto y medio del descanso. El equipo local estaba desbordado y el Casademont se iba al descanso con una ventaja amplia (28-52). El Leyma se desangraban desde el triple tres convertidos de 17 intentos. El Leyma en la reanudación se mostró impreciso y con muchas pérdidas evitables. El Casademont con la experiencia de Brussino y Jaworski ampliaban la diferencia y doblaban ya en el marcador al Leyma (30-62). Tiraron de amor propio y basado en una buena defensa el Leyma colocó un parcial de trece a uno (43-63). Terminó el tercer cuarto con 17 arriba para los visitantes (50-67). La defensa de Jacobo Díaz y de Skapintsev seguía acercando a los coruñeses. El Leyma tiene una asignatura pendiente desde que volvió a la ACB: no es intenso en defensa y el rival siempre obtiene tiros fáciles. En esta ocasión no fue diferente. En el último cuarto se volvieron a ver las carencias de los naranjas. Un triple de Jaworski volvia a poner una ventaja considerable (57-76). El bajo porcentaje desde la línea de tres puntos penalizó mucho al Leyma (7-39). El Casademont estuvo en porcentajes muy buenos en facetas como el triple (68%) y en rebotes defensivos (27). Al final victoria justa, cómoda y muy importante para el Casademont Zaragoza (71-92).

articles.title: ‘Suck It’: Sophie Cunningham Responds to NY Times Writer Who Called for Her to Be Traded Over Trans Comments
articles.summary: Sophie Cunningham has two words for The Athletic writer Candace Buckner, after she wrote the Indiana Fever should trade her for being a distraction: "s*ck it...
articles.body:
Sophie Cunningham has two words for The Athletic columnist Candace Buckner : "s*ck it."

The WNBA star punched back at the writer on the Friday episode of her No Hesitation podcast, three days after Bucker wrote in The New York Times -owned sports outlet the Indiana Fever should trade Cunningham.

Why? Because Cunningham is way too controversial to have her on the same team as Caitlin Clark , Bucker argued.

"Cunningham is too combustible, her takes too turbulent to be paired with Caitlin Clark. On the same team, it's just too much," Buckner wrote .

"Clark, by her presence alone, already can't get through a season without being thrown into gutter debates that pit White against Black; hate that appears even in the DMs of her own teammates. Cunningham, with only a few words, introduced new divisions."

In particular, Buckner was upset with Cunningham's comments to ESPN over the summer, where she said she did not support men who have transitioned competing against women.

Here is Cunningham's exact quote, which sparked a whole saga and plopped her in the center of a months-long media firestorm:

"I got a lot of negative feedback about me hating trans. And I'm like, 'I never once said that,'" [Cunningham] said. "I think that I am here to extend love. But I also think with that love is truth, being honest. And I want to protect young girls in a locker room, or young girls in sport who shouldn't have to go against biological men."

Cunningham's stance on trans athletes gave WNBA haters a golden opportunity to "disrupt" the league, Buckner said, which was made all the more sickening because the WNBA is "powered by the LGBTQIA community."

When her co-host Drew Hanlen brought up the article on their podcast, Cunningham said she wasn't losing sleep over critics like Buckner:

I literally don't even care what anybody says about me anymore, because I've said this so many times — if you're going to live by the praise, you're going to die by the hate. The majority of these have never picked up a ball in their entire lives and they're just like thirsty to like, have attention or be relevant in some type of way. No matter what anybody says to me, I'm going to continue to do me. I know what I bring to the table, it's not always in the stat sheet. And so, for you to like, not say I'm effective or any of that, whatever, s*ck it.

I literally don't even care what anybody says about me anymore, because I've said this so many times — if you're going to live by the praise, you're going to die by the hate.

No matter what anybody says to me, I'm going to continue to do me. I know what I bring to the table, it's not always in the stat sheet. And so, for you to like, not say I'm effective or any of that, whatever, s*ck it.

Her reaction comes as she has seemingly shrugged off most of the criticism aimed at her over the last few months, like when she jumped on a bar top and started belting a country tune.

Her podcast, meanwhile, has been generating some headlines, after she told WNBA MVP A'ja Wilson to "grow up" last week, following a bizarre confrontation with a fan.

articles.title: Kyrie Irving sends message to Mavericks fans before making return from injury
articles.summary: The Dallas Mavericks are under two weeks away from kicking off their 2026 regular season. This season will mark the return of point guard Kyrie Irving, who...
articles.body:
The Dallas Mavericks are under two weeks away from kicking off their 2026 regular season. This season will mark the return of point guard Kyrie Irving , who missed all of last year after tearing his ACL shortly after the Luka Doncic trade in 2025.

Now, Irving has spoken directly to Mavericks fans as he prepares to make his return to the court.

"I want to give a huge shoutout to my MFFL's because we've been very patient and they've been very patient with me. I'm just looking forward to getting back home and playing a few games in front of them, and just getting my feet wet… having that crowd pop again," he said, per DLLS Mavs on X, formerly Twitter.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

This year will mark the first time that Irving shares the court with rising star Cooper Flagg, who was named the NBA Rookie of the Year for his efforts last season, narrowly beating former Duke teammate Kon Knueppel for the award.

While some fans have questioned whether Irving, considering his age and injury history, makes sense sticking around with a Mavericks team that is clearly rebuilding, the team has given no indication that it is looking to trade him, and the multi-time All-Star has looked a lot like his usual self in workout footage that has been released over the last several months.

If Irving can resume his All-NBA form, it's not off the table that the Mavericks could compete for a playoff spot in a top-heavy Western Conference, especially if Flagg takes the expected leap in his development, particularly his outside shooting, heading into this year.

In any case, the Mavericks are slated to kick off their new season on October 21 on the road vs the Houston Rockets.

articles.title: 5-Star Guard GG Banks Commits to Play for Dawn Staley, South Carolina over Texas, LSU
articles.summary: Five-star combo guard Jezelle "GG" Banks committed to South Carolina on Saturday, according to ESPN's Shane Laflin.
articles.body:
Five-star combo guard Jezelle "GG" Banks committed to South Carolina on Saturday, according to ESPN's Shane Laflin .

Banks is the No. 4 overall player and ranks first at her position in 247Sports' composite rankings for the 2027 class. She had narrowed her list of finalists to the Gamecocks and SEC rivals LSU and Texas.

The 5'9" playmaker is the second 2027 commit for coach Dawn Staley after fellow guard Taylor Brown . Center Zaniya Johnson could be the next in line .

The Gamecocks had the No. 2 class for 2026, a group that included four 5-star prospects: guard Jerzy Robinson, forwards Kaeli Wynn and Oliviyah Edwards and center Kelsi Andrews.

South Carolina is a Final Four mainstay under Staley, winning titles in 2017, 2022 and 2024. The success of Gamecocks legends A'ja Wilson, Aliyah Boston and Allisha Gray has served as a great advertisement for the program as well.

"From my first time meeting Dawn, to Coach [Jolette Law] and the staff making me feel right at home, I knew this was where I belonged," Banks told Laflin . "They never just recruited me as a player, they recruited me as a person, and they were honest with me about what it would take to get where I want to go. I want to compete for national championships, and I want to be pushed every single day."

Banks won a gold medal with the United States over the summer in the 2026 FIBA U18 Women's AmeriCup. She also participated in the Shooting Stars competition at WNBA All-Star Weekend. She teamed with the Washington Mystics' Shakira Austin and two-time WNBA MVP Elena Delle Donne to win.

Wilson and Boston, two frontcourt standouts, define the current era of South Carolina basketball more than anyone else.

Guard play has been a key facet of the team's dominance, though. Tyasha Harris, Destanni Henderson, Zia Cooke, Te-Hina Paopao and Raven Johnson all earned All-American honors in Columbia before moving on to the next level.

In a few years, Banks might be added to that list.

articles.title: Suns-Spurs preseason. Phoenix big battle open despite Ighodaro starts
articles.summary: The Phoenix Suns continue preseason action on Oct. 10 against the San Antonio Spurs at Mortgage Matchup Center.
articles.body:
Phoenix Suns coach Jordan Ott didn't second the notion that the center competition has already been decided as he spoke to the media on Friday, Oct. 9.

Oso Ighodaro has started the first two preseason games. He's battling 7-footer Khaman Maluach for the starting big position.

"We'll take the same preseason approach," Suns coach Jordan Ott said after Friday's practice. "Five of these games. Two young guys. They continue to get better. Have different gifts that we're still trying to figure out. Mix and match a little bit even in these last three games."

The Suns will play their third preseason game Saturday, Oct. 10, against the San Antonio Spurs at Mortgage Matchup Center.

Scenes from Phoenix Suns' 2026 preseason matchups

Ott could opt to start Maluach against Spurs phenom Victor Wembanyama, the reigning NBA Defensive Player of the Year who led San Antonio to the 2026 NBA Finals.

The Suns are 0-2 in preseason action, losing on the road to the Detroit Pistons and Chicago Bulls , while the Spurs enter their second preseason game 0-1 after falling 123-116 to the Atlanta Hawks on Oct. 8.

The Spurs were without De'Aaron Fox against the Hawks as he was a late scratch due to soreness from a rigorous workout, the San Antonio Express-News reported.

The Suns may be without Miles Bridges, who suffered a right ankle injury in the second quarter of Wednesday's game against the Bulls. Ott said x-rays were negative, but they plan to "be smart" with Bridges.

articles.body:
The Golden State Valkyries earned a new fan after punching their ticket to the WNBA Finals on Friday.

Following the Valkyries' series-clinching win over the Las Vegas Aces in the WNBA semifinals, Dallas Mavericks star Kyrie Irving took to social media to show love for the expansion team.

"Shoutout to the [Valkyries]," Iriving wrote. "Yall really are like that!! Got a lifelong supporter now!"

The Valkyries are in just their second season as a WNBA franchise, but that hasn't stopped them from establishing themselves as one of the best teams in the league. After reaching the playoffs last year, Golden State finished second in the WNBA during the regular season.

The Valkyries downed the Dallas Wings in the first round before sweeping the defending champion Aces and five-time MVP A'ja Wilson.

Led by arguably the best defense in the WNBA, the Valkyries will look to end their season on top, but they'll have to get through the Atlanta Dream, who have yet to lose a game in the playoffs so far.

El conjunto de Vidorreta tuvo que trabajar el triunfo en varias ocasiones después de llegar a dominar por 18 puntos, aunque los andorranos nunca dejaron de competir y obligaron a los malagueños a mantenerse concentrados hasta el final. Pantzar volvió a aprovechar su presencia en el quinteto inicial, mientras Noua, Perry y Hunt aportaban puntos importantes para abrir diferencias. El lituano firmó 19 puntos, cinco asistencias, cuatro rebotes y 27 de valoración, mostrando su capacidad para anotar desde fuera, atacar el aro y generar ventajas. articles.title: Celtics' Jaylen Brown Tribute Video Plans Revealed in New NBA Rumors After 76ers Trade
articles.summary: The Boston Celtics plan to honor their former star when he comes to town this season.
articles.body:
The Boston Celtics plan to honor their former star when he comes to town this season.

Per Adam Himmelsbach of the Boston Globe , the team plans to show a tribute video for Jaylen Brown when the Philadelphia 76ers play in Boston in January. The Celtics and Sixers play a preseason game on Saturday, but the tribute will be saved for the regular season.

The Celtics traded Brown to Philadelphia in July in exchange for Paul George and a package of draft picks, ending his 10-year run with the team that drafted him in 2016.

To see Brown get a tribute video is no surprise, considering he's one of the team's best players of the 21st century. He helped lead the team to a pair of Finals appearances, including a title in 2024. He was named the Eastern Conference MVP and the Finals MVP that year. He also earned five All-Star nods and two All-NBA Second Team honors while in Boston.

Celtics president of basketball operations Brad Stevens said the trade was motivated in part by financial considerations given Brown and Tatum are both on max contracts.

It's hard to imagine Celtics fans having any bitterness towards Brown since it wasn't his choice to leave, so he should receive a warm welcome when he returns to Boston.

Con el seleccionador Chus Mateo como espectador en la grada del Pazo, el equipo de Luis Casimiro exhibió todo su repertorio en los primeros 20 minutos para aniquilar al Girona. Del 25-22 en el minuto nueve se pasó al 36-24 en el arranque del segundo asalto. Moncho Fernández paró el partido porque su equipo estaba acumulando muchas pérdidas -siete en apenas 13 minutos- y era incapaz de frenar el altísimo ritmo de juego del conjunto celeste. Pero el parón no surgió efecto. Breogán siguió moviendo muy bien el balón y explotando su acierto exterior (6 triples en ese cuarto). La renta gallega alcanzó los 23 puntos (55-32) antes del intermedio. Nada cambió en la segunda parte. articles.title: Are Jaylen Brown, LeBron James Playing vs. Celtics? Latest Updates on 76ers Stars
articles.summary: The 76ers are set to face the Celtics in a preseason matchup Saturday. Here's the latest on Jaylen Brown and LeBron James' availability.
articles.body:
The Philadelphia 76ers made two major additions this offseason, bringing former Boston Celtics star Jaylen Brown and NBA legend LeBron James to Philadelphia. Now, the revamped roster has a chance to face Boston as the Eastern Conference rivals prepare for the 2026-27 NBA season.

Brown was traded to the 76ers in July after spending his entire career with the Celtics, while James joined Philadelphia in free agency. Their arrivals have raised expectations for a team looking to contend for an NBA championship.

The 76ers are scheduled to face the Celtics in a preseason matchup on Saturday, Oct. 10, at TD Garden. Here's the latest on Brown and James ahead of the matchup.

Are Jaylen Brown, LeBron James playing vs. Celtics?

Jaylen Brown and LeBron James will all sit out Saturday's preseason game between the Philadelphia 76ers and Boston Celtics, according to Sixers PR .

Two days after starting Brown, James, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe and Joel Embiid against the Brooklyn Nets, Philadelphia will rest Embiid, James and Brown against Boston. Brown will have to wait until Philadelphia's first regular-season trip to Boston to return to TD Garden, where he spent 10 seasons with the Celtics before joining the 76ers.

How 76ers acquired Jaylen Brown, LeBron James?

Philadelphia significantly reshaped its roster during the offseason, starting with a trade for Brown and following it with the addition of James.

Brown was traded by Boston to Philadelphia in July in a deal that sent Paul George and draft picks to the Celtics. The move ended Brown's tenure with Boston, where he won an NBA championship in 2024 and earned NBA Finals MVP honors.

The trade also gave Brown a fresh start after a difficult end to his relationship with the Celtics organization. Although he acknowledged that he was still processing the move, he expressed excitement about joining a new team with championship ambitions.

James joined Philadelphia in free agency, giving the 76ers another superstar to pair with Embiid and Maxey. The four-time NBA champion entered his 24th NBA season with an opportunity to help Philadelphia compete in a crowded Eastern Conference.

With Brown, James, Embiid and Maxey leading the way, the 76ers have assembled a star-studded lineup. Their matchup against Boston could offer an early glimpse of how the new-look Philadelphia roster measures up against one of its biggest rivals.
